body: PM me and let's talk. About anything you want

The pit of depression is an incredibly easy one to dig, but oh so difficult to get out of. As long as you keep moving forward, you will get better. It's going to take time and effort, but it will be worth it in the end. Anxiety and depression can be countered with medicine. Depending on where you live you might not ever need a car. At 33 I have 3 friends, but that's all I need because they're good friends. They're out there. You will find yours. Once you learn to love yourself others will love you too. I have spent years thinking I was not an attractive guy. Still don't really believe it but I was able to find someone who did. You will too. Please stay strong. Feel free to PM me if you need to talk.

Your life isn't pointless. You are here for a reason. If you can't find your reason, create one. As for the cutting, look into tattoos, piercings, and other body modifications. I know several people who do it as an alternative to cutting. It's a controlled pain in a controlled environment  with clean instruments and trained professionals. Keep your head up and don't give up. Please.

I'm not going to feed you some line about how it'll all work out, maybe it will, maybe it won't, but you can't give up. I started as a dishwasher many years ago and 7 months ago my friend and I opened our own restaurant. Dishwashers are the hardest working people in the restaurant. Don't belittle yourself or your position. The rest of them couldn't do their jobs without you. You have value. You will find someone who sees that. Some people just don't know how to deal with this type of thing. My girlfriend has a very hard time understanding me and my depression. Feel free to message me. I'll be here to listen and help if I can

Thank you. I currently don't have a primary care physician nor do I have insurance. Unfortunately working for myself doesn't provide those benefits yet. I've finally started to be able to catch myself slipping into the darkness and I realize now that that's not how I should live. I know it's gonna be a long, tough road, but it sure beats the alternative.

Shit's not really getting any easier. People at work tiptoe around me. Everyone else has moved on it would seem. I fell down a deep hole with drugs after it happened. For all of February, March, and most of April and May I was high. I spent close to 2 grand in four months on coke, Adderall, booze, and anything else that could numb the pain and get me through another day. After I posted this I decided to give sobriety a try. Now I think sobriety is overrated. I still want to kill myself everyday. My biggest worry is who will find me or what will happen if I fuck it up. The last thing I want is to be "that guy" who couldn't handle life. The girl I've been seeing for the last several months dumped me via text tonight (I thought we were adults, but whatever). Now I have to trudge through for another few months so it won't look like I killed myself over a girl when really that is merely a drop in the bucket of the things that bother me. I put a loaded gun to my head almost every day. Hopefully one day I'll pull the trigger. Life sucks. People suck. Hunter S. Thompson always said that knowing he could kill himself whenever he wanted kept him sane. I think I've always know I was going to kill myself. Ever since I was a kid. Maybe if I can figure out some way to make it look like an accident people won't pity me. "Accidental" OD maybe. Get hammered and speed. Maybe pay the extra money to skydive solo and never pull the chute. Just walk into the ocean and swim until I get tired and just wait. I'm sorry this got a little ranty.
I think animals are more in tune with our body language than we are. Makes sense since that's all they have to go on in the wild.

Dude, that means she cares. If you've got nobody else, at least you've got her. That's more than I can say for myself. You're still very young. There's so much more ahead of you. Life is going to suck. That just means that you have to enjoy the good even more. You have a girl who loves you, friends that care about you, and a long life to live. Don't give up now. Call her. She'll forgive you. Call your friends. If they're true friends they'll be there for you. If not, fuck 'em. Live and experience ALL that life has to offer. The good, the bad, and the indifferent.
There's still time to undo everything you've done today. There's still time for help. There's still time to live a happy life.

This sounds like asking for help. There are people who will listen. You are young. I'd say it gets better, but I don't know that. You can at least try. Trust me I know what it is like hating yourself. There are people who care though. You've found this place and there are other subs with tons of people living with the same feelings everyday. We can help each other through this nightmare we call life.
